headline: Front-Line Ledger Turns on Six Sectors
war_summary: The latest returns show the battle still pivoting around contested ground, with several earlier alarms now losing steam. WeatheredExpanseHex remains the busiest ledger, posting thirty-four strategic-base events in twenty-four hours and six in the latest two-hour window; its holdings stand at five Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral. LinnMercyHex has quickened sharply, with two events in two hours, twenty in the day, and casualty and enlistment rates accelerating on both sides; one Warden base faces ten Colonial holdings. FishermansRowHex records forty-two daily events, though only two in six hours and none in the newest two-hour spell, leaving two Warden, six Colonial, and one neutral base. StlicanShelfHex has thirty-five daily events and one in six hours, while MooringCountyHex shows eighteen daily events and three in six hours amid rapidly rising losses and enlistments. CallahansPassageHex remains a major manpower furnace—casualties and enlistments are surging—but no strategic-base events were logged. Quiet sectors elsewhere offer little immediate evidence of ownership change.
